title: Quarterly roadmap orchestration for Private Deployments — FastPath cadence
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Goal: Define a compact, outcome-driven Q2 roadmap ('FastPath') that delivers a minimal but production-ready subset of Private/VPC/on-prem features for enterprise customers. This ticket coordinates milestone mapping, OKR alignment, rollout gates, and cross-functional responsibilities so the PM, Eng, Design, Security and Sales teams can run a coherent pilot and early GA in Q2.

Scope (FastPath subset):
- VPC peering and customer-controlled network egress policies (core connectivity)
- KMS integration for tenant key management (customer-managed keys)
- Upgrade orchestration & rollback for Private control plane (safety automation)
- Tenant isolation: initial RBAC mapping + auditing hooks (compliance minimum)
- Canary routing for model variants (operational fallback)

Why FastPath: Many customers need a predictable, minimal feature set to adopt Private deployments without waiting for the full platform parity. FastPath reduces delivery surface area, shortens validation cycles, and ties directly to revenue-convertible pilots.

OKR alignment (examples):
- OKR A: Reduce time-to-first-private-request for pilot customers to <7 days (KR: onboarding checklist automation complete).
- OKR B: Achieve SLO compliance for private pilots (99.5% uptime during pilot windows).
- OKR C: Close 2 enterprise deals referencing FastPath in Q2 (pilot->paid conversion).

Milestones & cadence (high level):
- Week 1–2 (Design & Spec): finalize minimal API contract, network diagrams, KMS operator surface, and upgrade runbook.
- Week 3–5 (Core Engineering): implement VPC peering primitives, KMS key handshake tests, and RBAC baseline.
- Week 6 (Canary + Rollout): routing policy + automated fallback test harness.
- Week 7–8 (Security & Compliance validation): pen-test window, SOC review checklist, audit log retention config.
- Week 9–10 (Pilot): onboard first customer (FinTier Health), run 2-week pilot with telemetry collection.
- Week 11–12 (GA readiness): fix pilot regressions, prepare release notes, sales enablement collateral.

Acceptance gating: every milestone must include a short acceptance checklist (see acceptance_criteria). If any gate is failed, the default action is to run a controlled rollback and shift the milestone by 1 sprint.

Notes on scope boundary: FastPath intentionally omits advanced autoscaling, full console UIs, advanced network topologies (e.g., multi-VPC mesh), and extended audit retention — these are deferred to subsequent tranches.

Delivery owners: PM (Maya) coordinates; Eng leads: Liam (runtime/orchestration), Priya Rao (security); Design lead: Elena Kim; Sales/CS pilot lead: Jorge Martinez.
acceptance_criteria: Automated VPC peering scripts complete end-to-end test in customer sandbox
KMS integration completes key rotation and customer-managed key validation in 2 environments
Upgrade orchestration performs a planned upgrade and successful rollback in the staging control plane
RBAC baseline enforces tenant-isolation for at least 3 role templates and generates audit logs
Canary routing triggers fallback when a variant breach is detected in latency or error threshold
Pilot customer (FinTier Health) completes onboarding and runs a 1-week production-like workload with SLOs observed
